chunks: Such then is God, your true Lord; and when truth is gone what is left but error? So why do you turn away?
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of turning away from the truth according to this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Yunus, this verse serves as a decisive conclusion to the discourse on divine unity, asserting that Allah alone is the absolute truth (Al-Haqq). Shia scholars emphasize the rhetorical force of 'fa anna tusrafun' (how are you averted?) as a challenge to human free will, questioning why rational beings would voluntarily turn away from clear evidence towards deviation. It underscores the inevitability of error when truth is rejected, highlighting the spiritual consequence of misguidance.
